title: Ukraine foils Russia’s ‘Bear’s Corner’ encirclement plan in Kharkiv region – military spox
summary: Russian forces were already reporting the success of their ‘Bear’s Corner’ operation in the Kharkiv region before they had even launched it.

title: UK to provide £9.5 mln for construction of wind farm in Ukraine
summary: The United Kingdom will provide £9.5 million (nearly $12.5 million) to support the construction of a new 200 MW wind farm in Ukraine.

title: SSU detains serviceman suspected of guiding Russian strikes at Ukraine’s Defense Forces in Donetsk region
summary: The military counterintelligence unit of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU), with the assistance of the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, has detained a serviceman in the Donetsk region suspected of providing Russia with the coordinates of Ukrainian Defense Forces units and military facilities.

title: 20 tonnes of medicines and medical equipment arrive in Zakarpattia from Hungary
summary: A consignment of medicines and medical equipment from Hungary has arrived in the Zakarpattia region.

title: Lithuania calls for Russia’s GRU to be designated terrorist organization
summary: The Main Directorate of the General Staff of the Russian Armed Forces (GRU) should be recognised as a terrorist organisation by the European Union, as this intelligence service ‘terrorises’ the populations of European countries.

title: 1,200 civilians remain in Druzhkivka community in Donetsk region
summary: There are still 1,200 civilians in the Druzhkivka urban territorial community in Donetsk region, and due to the extremely difficult security situation, evacuations from the area have almost come to a halt.

title: Enemy attack sparks warehouse fire in Bila Tserkva district
summary: In the Bila Tserkva district, a fire has broken out in a warehouse following an enemy attack; emergency services are on the scene.
